_note: Hospital billing contacts, each traced to the hospital's own pages. A field is null when the hospital does not publish it. Nothing here is guessed. Hospitals rarely publish a billing email, so most entries have a phone number and a billing page only. Re-check an entry before relying on it: hospitals change these. verification_status is 'verified' when the official page lists the contact and 'listed' when it comes from a brochure or secondary source.

providers.name: Cedars-Sinai Medical Center
providers.notes: The billing email is in a Cedars-Sinai billing brochure and a third-party listing, not on the main billing page, so confirm it before relying on it. The phone is on the official billing page. Patient Financial Services also lists 323-866-8600. The advocacy address handles billing complaints and concerns.

providers.name: Mass General Brigham
providers.notes: The email is for general questions only, with a reply in about three business days. For disputes and settlement offers, Mass General Brigham asks for mail to Patient Billing Solutions, 399 Revolution Drive, Suite 410, Somerville, MA 02145-1462, or a phone call.

providers.name: Logan Health (formerly North Valley Hospital, Whitefish)
providers.notes: North Valley Hospital became Logan Health - Whitefish in 2021 and uses Logan Health's Patient Accounting office in Kalispell. Shelby uses a different billing line, 406-434-3205.

providers.name: Sutter Health
providers.notes: Sutter publishes no general billing email. The phone is the general billing line, (800) 4Sutter, weekdays 7 am to 7 pm PT. Billing questions go to the Sutter affiliate that treated the patient or the number on the statement. The email is the Patient Resource Center for patient questions and concerns, (800) 866-7724. It is not billing-specific.

providers.name: UCLA Health
providers.notes: No billing email is published. The phone is Ronald Reagan UCLA Medical Center billing. UCLA Mattel Children's Hospital is 310-825-8021, UCLA Santa Monica is 310-825-8325, and UCLA West Valley is 855-337-9915. Hospitals and physicians in California often bill separately.
